title: Alexis Ohanian says building social networks is no longer cool
teaser: Reddit co-founder Alexis Ohanian believes social networks are losing their former purpose, and that an improved group chat could be the future of user-generated content. At the debut WIRED World Fair, he said the internet is increasingly being built for AI agents rather than people, making it vulnerable to manipulation. Ohanian, who runs venture firm Seven Seven Six with more than $1.3 billion in assets, expects AI to drive breakthroughs in medicine, though he acknowledges the technology can also cause serious harm.
